policy.coordinate_system: Export pixels, top-left origin; applies to complete lettering and outline bounds
policy.placement: Upper screen below platform headers, all captions and taglines; never bottom
policy.reserved_artwork_clearance: Keep important faces, heads, signs and camera pushes below export y=800px; plain background in caption band
policy.font: Arial Black or equally bold; white with thick black outline
policy.fit: Wrap main text to 2–3 lines, fit measured full glyph and outline bounds, shorten wrapping or recompose rather than use bottom placement; captions remain fixed during shake
policy.verification: Check title, subtitle, tag and all animated caption bounds against both reference header masks before rendering; inspect final phone-scale previews

reference_measurement.mapping: Account conservatively for phone viewport scaling/cropping; measure rendered-video bounds, not the phone status bar alone
reference_measurement.limitation: Measured from the user's screenshots, not a guarantee for every future app UI, expanded overlay or device crop

policy.scope: All future videos, unless the user explicitly changes the rule
